_patch.note_add: The City of High Point's campground page gives the same $45 for full-service sites and $35 for Section D, each for up to four people.

fees.note: Read on the Campspot marketplace: one night for 2 adults, site rate before tax, on the Deluxe RV Site, the only RV type the park sells by the night: $55 on Tuesdays from October 20 to November 10, 2026, and $56 on Saturday, December 5.  Every Saturday from October 17 to November 21 was $100, and each one not sold out asked for 2 nights.  The Economy RV Sites ask for 30 nights and the Economy PLUS Concrete sites for 7; the park rents them by the month from $550 plus power.  Campspot adds its own booking fee at checkout (3%, at least $3).  Read 2026-10-13.

source: https://www.campspot.com/park/clemson-hills-rv-club-seneca-sc (Campspot's pricing for the Deluxe RV Site, one night from 2026-10-17 and 2026-10-20, 2 adults, campspot_tier_2026-10-13.jsonl; campspot_dates.py for Saturdays and Tuesdays from October 24 to December 5, 2026, each type's price with Campspot's $3 fee folded in); https://www.clemsonhills.com/ (monthly rates), read 2026-10-13
